# Third-party provenance

No third-party source code is currently vendored in the RL extension. `NOTICE` records
the conceptual TurtleBot3 reference and the retained TurtleBot4 repository history.

If a future dependency must be vendored, place it in a named subdirectory with its
license and upstream notice. Record repository URL, immutable revision, source paths,
local modifications, and license in both this directory and `NOTICE`. Prefer normal
system/Python dependencies over vendoring when practical.
